data.name: Huraiba
data.gender_notes: Huraiba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-r-b', meaning 'to break'. Huraiba is a name of great beauty, signifying a gentle, soft, delicate, and beautiful individual. The name Huraiba carries the meaning “Gentle, soft, delicate, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Huraiba usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soft, delicate, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Huraiba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, soft, delicate, beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Huraiba total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Huraiba
in_english.long_meaning: Huraiba is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from 'haraba' which means 'free' or 'independent'. The name connotes self-respect, purity, and dignity. In Islamic tradition, it signifies a woman who maintains her honor and integrity. The etymology of Huraiba can be traced back to the Arabic root 'h-r-b' which is also related to concepts of freedom and self-reliance. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a woman of strong character and moral values.

The name carries a gentle and elegant sound which is soothing to the ears and reflects the kindness and compassion that is expected from Muslims. Its origin from the Arabic language and its roots being found in the rich literary and historical Islamic tradition, make it a name deeply connected to Islamic culture.

The Arabic root 'h-r-b' represents the act of breaking, which in Islamic spirituality is often described as the breaking of various barriers that separate the individual from Allah. This reminds us of the St verse in the Quran which says, "I have only created jinn and Humankind so that they may serve Me." (51:56) The name thus serves as a constant reminder for the bearer to remain steadfast in their faith and to continuously strive towards spiritual growth and closeness to Allah. Ultimately, the name Huraiba is a reflection of the divine love and compassion that exists between the Creator and the created.
